customerName.title: Customer Name
customerName.description: Visitor name. Falls back to the email handle when blank.

durationMinutes.title: Duration (Minutes)
durationMinutes.description: Slot length in minutes when no End Time (IST Text) is given. Leave blank to use the 60 minute default.

endTimeText.title: End Time (IST Text)
endTimeText.description: Optional slot end as plain text in India Standard Time, formatted yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm on a 24 hour clock. Leave blank to use Duration (Minutes) instead.

mediatorId.title: Mediator Id
mediatorId.description: Contact Id of the mediator taking the visit, taken from the Get Mediator result for the option the visitor picked. Always pass this when it is known.

mediatorName.title: Mediator Name
mediatorName.description: Mediator name, used only when no Mediator Id is known.

parentRecordId.title: Parent Record Id
parentRecordId.description: Optional. Overrides the Lead the appointment is filed under. Leave blank.

propertyId.title: Property Id
propertyId.description: Id of the property being visited, taken from the Get Properties result. Always pass this when it is known.

propertyName.title: Property Name
propertyName.description: Project name, used only when no Property Id is known.

startTimeText.title: Start Time (IST Text)
startTimeText.description: Required. The confirmed date and time as plain text in India Standard Time, formatted yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm on a 24 hour clock, e.g. 2026-09-09 15:00 for 3 PM.
